items.verified_claim: For intra-arterial iodinated contrast, discontinue metformin at or before the procedure, re-evaluate eGFR 48 hours later, and restart if renal function is stable.

corrected_options.A: Continue metformin and lisinopril; check renal function only if urine output declines after contrast exposure.
corrected_options.B: Withhold metformin at or before contrast, recheck renal function after 48 hours, and restart it if stable.
corrected_options.C: Withhold lisinopril but continue metformin because ACE inhibition is the main medication-related contrast concern.
corrected_options.D: Continue both medications and rely on oral hydration alone to reduce the risk of contrast-associated kidney injury.
